presets.customTagline: Your key, its address and docs

gemini.description: Generate and edit images with Nano Banana (Google's Gemini image models): illustrations, product shots, photo edits, images with text.

openai.description: Images with GPT Image (generate and edit), plus OpenAI's GPT models for text and vision, text-to-speech and transcription.

elevenlabs.description: Lifelike speech in many voices and languages, sound effects from a description, and speech-to-text.

replicate.description: Run open models for images (FLUX), video, audio, upscaling and background removal.

perplexity.description: Up-to-date answers from the web with cited sources: research, news, fact checks.

plugins.onBody: Its code runs in your agents' sessions on your computer.

tools.label: Sees and changes tool calls
tools.detail: It can block a tool call, rewrite its input or act on its result.

prompts.label: Reads and rewrites prompts
prompts.detail: It sees what is sent to the agent and can change it, the system prompt included.

transcript.label: Edits what the conversation keeps
transcript.detail: It can rewrite messages and tool results before the model reads them.

turns.label: Follows the agent's turns
turns.detail: It is told when a turn starts, takes a step and ends.

notes.label: Posts notes into the chat
notes.detail: Its log lines, toasts and status show up in the chat as notes from the mod.

panes.label: Draws panes and bands
panes.detail: These show in Claude Code's own terminal and desktop app, not in Godmode's chats.

model.label: Calls the model
model.detail: It can ask Claude questions of its own, which costs tokens.

store.label: Remembers things between chats
store.detail: It keeps values of its own across sessions.

files_read.label: Reads files on this computer
files_read.detail: It can read any file the agent's run can read.

files_write.label: Writes files on this computer
files_write.detail: It can create and overwrite files.

process.label: Runs programs on this computer
process.detail: It can start commands of its own, outside the agent's tools.

network.label: Talks to the internet
network.detail: It can send requests to any server.

programs.label: Starts programs of its own
programs.detail: It ships command hooks, servers, monitors or scripts that Claude Code runs on this computer.

abilities.skillsDetail: Instructions the agent loads when a task needs them, or when you name them.
abilities.subagentsDetail: Specialists the agent can hand parts of its work to.
abilities.commandsDetail: Prompts you or the agent start with a /name.
abilities.hooksDetail: Shell commands on this computer on {{events}}.
abilities.hooksDetailMore: Shell commands on this computer on {{events}} and more.
abilities.mcpServersDetail: Programs on this computer that give the agent tools of their own.
